letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you.  
Your smile turns our bustling days into sweet lullabies, and your love is the gentle anchor that steadies my heart.  
I’m counting down the moments until we’re together again, hand in hand, as the calendar whispers our next adventure.
poem:
In desert sands or rain‑kissed streets,  
Your laughter is the rhythm my heart repeats.  
Across the miles, our love’s a bright, bold hue—  
Together, forever, just me and you.
